en.加密迁移临时文件已存在：: Encrypted migration temporary file already exists:

en.数据库校验未通过，原记录保持不变。: Database verification failed. The original history was kept.
en.无法关闭原数据库的写入日志，未进行加密迁移。: Could not close the database write log. Encryption migration was canceled.
en.无法确认开机启动设置，请重试。: Unable to confirm startup settings, please try again.
en.暂时无法读取公开版本。请稍后重试或访问 GitHub 发布页。: The public version cannot be read at the moment. Please try again later or visit the GitHub releases page.
en.更改语言后重启 ClipNest 生效。: Restart ClipNest to apply the new language.
en.更改路径时会先迁移并校验数据，成功后才删除旧数据库。: ClipNest moves and verifies the data before removing the old database.

en.查看加密记录的位置，并管理本地数据库。: View and manage your encrypted local history.
en.此选项在 ClipNest.exe 中可用: Available in the installed ClipNest app
en.清空所有未收藏的历史记录？此操作无法撤销。: Delete all history items outside favorites? This cannot be undone.
en.点击按钮检查 GitHub 上的最新版本。: Check GitHub for the latest version.
en.点击放大镜收起搜索: Click the magnifier to close search
en.目标位置已有备份或密钥文件，请选择新的文件名。: A backup or key file already exists at the destination location, please choose a new file name.
en.目标位置已有数据库密钥文件，请选择空目录。: The database key file already exists in the target location, please select an empty directory.
en.目标位置已有未完成的备份文件，请选择其他文件名。: There is an unfinished backup file in the destination location. Please choose another file name.
en.窗口透明度 · 默认与黑暗模式共用: Window opacity · Default and dark modes
en.请按下带修饰键的组合；Ctrl+数字、搜索键和快速粘贴键已保留。: Please press modifier key combinations; Ctrl+Number, Search, and Quick Paste are reserved.
en.请设置带 Ctrl、Alt、Shift 或 Win 的字母、数字、F1–F12: Set a letter, number, F1–F12, or space combination with Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Win, and do not use Ctrl+Shift+C.
en.调整外观、呼出方式和日常使用习惯。: Customize appearance, shortcuts, and everyday behavior.
en.还没有记录。复制文字、链接、图片或文件后，它们会出现在这里。: No records yet. After you copy text, links, images, or files, they will appear here.
en.这个收藏夹名称已存在。: A favorite folder with this name already exists.
en.这个组合已用于呼出 ClipNest，请换一个。: This shortcut already opens ClipNest. Choose another.
en.这个组合已用于收藏夹「: This shortcut is already used by “
en.这个组合已用于收藏夹切换或快速粘贴，请换一个。: This shortcut is used for favorites or quick paste. Choose another.
en.这个组合键已被其他应用占用，请换一个组合。: Another app is using this shortcut. Choose another.
en.选择卡片后直接粘贴到刚才的应用: Paste selected items into the previous app
en.重启 ClipNest 后，界面将使用所选语言。: Restart ClipNest to use the selected language.
